prescription.eligibility: tightId and pfRelIso04_all < 0.15 and abs(eta) < 2.4; finite pT/phi and charge +/-1; scale input pT in [26,200] GeV.
prescription.nominal_mc: Scale with m_mc/a_mc, then pT_scale*(1+K*sigma*CBdraw), with K=sqrt(max(0,k_data^2-k_mc^2)).
prescription.resolution_domain: Scaled MC pT in [26,200] GeV. Scale-only if this guard is not satisfied.
prescription.randomness: Payload RandomSmearing(event, luminosityBlock, phi), then symmetric double-sided Crystal Ball inverse CDF. Same draw for nominal and every variation.
prescription.scale_uncertainty: m_mc/a_mc stat and syst with matching rho_stat/rho_syst. These errors already include data and MC.
prescription.resolution_uncertainty: k_mc stat and syst are errors on residual K; use max(0,K +/- deltaK), with no division by K. Floor inactive for released 2024 nominal bins.
prescription.total_nuisance_model: Two independent scale and resolution sources; stat and syst combined in quadrature within each. Component pTs also saved. Do not count totals and components as independent in the same fit.
prescription.out_of_domain: Input pT preserved with explicit coverage status; no extrapolation or high-pT GE bias applied to ordinary MC.
prescription.met_propagation: Not applied; optional in supplied JMAR prescription.
prescription.insertion: Before good_muons; active pT feeds selection, trigger choice, jet cleaning, generator matching and lepton SFs.

coverage_codes.5: MC scale only, scaled pT outside resolution domain

output.per_muon: PtRaw, PtNominal, PtScale, NanoIdx, MomentumStatus, four total and eight component shifted pTs; Pt is the active pass.
output.passes: --muon-pt-variation all writes nominal plus four complete total-shift passes in separate directories, from the same input NanoAOD.
output.normalization: Normalize each copy using the same all-input denominator; never sum repeated totals across momentum passes.
output.weight_systematics_flag: Independent of --muon-pt-variation; nominal muon correction is enabled by default.
output.condor: Existing templates still submit nominal; no batch production was submitted.
